market.n: Zodwa's Fruit & Veg — Soweto Canvas I
market.d: Original oil on canvas by Grand Mashadlela. Depicts the iconic Zodwa's Fruit & Veg stall in Soweto with vibrant community figures. Canvas board, small format. Hand-signed. One of a kind.

market.n: Zodwa's Fruit & Veg — Soweto Canvas II
market.d: Original oil on board by Grand Mashadlela. A second interpretation of Zodwa's iconic market stall — raw, expressive brushwork captures the energy of township commerce. Hand-signed.
Original oil on board. Three traditional rondavels beneath a flame-red autumn tree with sweeping mountain backdrop. Serene, spiritual and deeply rooted in Xhosa/Sotho heritage. Hand-signed.
Original oil on board. A lively queue outside a township shop with Coca-Cola signage — a moment of everyday life immortalised in vivid colour. Hand-signed by Grand Mashadlela.
Original oil on board. The famous Thandabantu General Dealer — a cultural hub of township life. Bold composition, joyful crowd, golden light. Hand-signed by Grand Mashadlela.
Original oil on board. Friends and family gathered in a corrugated iron backyard on a sun-drenched afternoon. Intimate, warm, timeless township energy. Hand-signed.
Original oil on board. Two women pounding grain outside a single rondavel beneath a blue-drenched tree. A meditation on ritual, rhythm and rural womanhood. Hand-signed.
Original oil on board. A sweeping aerial view of a township stretching to the horizon — hundreds of homes, a community in motion. Grand Mashadlela's most panoramic composition. Hand-signed.

market.n: Sunset Over the Settlement — Crimson Dusk
market.d: Original oil on board. A fiery crimson sunset bathes the township in golden-red light. Trees silhouetted, figures moving home. One of Grand Mashadlela's most emotive works. Dated 2024. Hand-signed.
Original oil on board. A township street transformed by a canopy of purple jacaranda blooms. Figures stroll beneath violet light. Possibly the most beloved piece in this collection. Hand-signed.
Original oil on board. Three rondavels beneath an autumn flame tree — a companion piece to Autumn Homeland I with richer detail and warmer tones. Figures at rest and work. Hand-signed.

market.n: Fruitful Street — The Brand on the Hill
market.d: Original oil on board. A township street scene with the iconic @Fruitful@ billboard rising above corrugated rooftops. A historic document of brand presence in the community. Hand-signed.
Original oil on board. A red bus at a township stop at golden hour — passengers boarding under a warm sunset glow. 'SIYA' reads the shelter. Movement, community, departure. Hand-signed.
Original oil on board. A second Fruitful billboard scene in full daylight — brighter palette, more detail in the community movement below the iconic sign. Hand-signed by Grand Mashadlela.

Fruitful Kids Creative Aprons for Little Helpers — beautifully designed children's aprons in vibrant fruit & floral prints. Fostering creativity & fun in the kitchen. Available in multiple patterns. Proudly Fruitful.

isAmpokwe (Traditional name meaning: Impala). Traditional Xhosa and Zulu beadwork on white straw. Vibrant multicolour geometric Ndebele brim with bold primary colours — red, blue, yellow, green. The Fruitful logo beaded in full colour on a crisp white crown. The grace and agility of the Impala.

Captured live at the Mamelodi market — Grand Sibangilizwe painting the 'Be Fruitful' fedora by hand. White straw crown with the iconic Fruitful logo hand-lettered in gold, with a tricolour woven brim band. Each hat is one-of-a-kind, signed by the artisan.

Elim · Limpopo — authentic Venda handmade clay pots, hand-shaped and fired using ancestral techniques passed down through generations. Each pot features traditional geometric engravings inspired by Venda, Ndebele and Sotho patterns. Proudly Fruitful. Changing. Seeds.

uNtshontsho (Traditional name meaning: Cape Buffalo). Traditional Xhosa and Zulu beadwork on natural straw. High-contrast geometric checkered beadwork with the Fruitful logo. A symbol of solidity, power, and grounded energy from the South African savanna.

uMkhombe (Traditional name meaning: Rhinoceros). Traditional Xhosa and Zulu beadwork on solid straw crown. Rich tan straw with ndebele-inspired geometric brim painting and Zulu bead band. The strength and dignity of the Rhinoceros.

uMkhombe (Traditional name meaning: Rhinoceros). Traditional Xhosa and Zulu beadwork on white straw. Vivid ndebele-pattern brim painting and Zulu bead band on crisp white crown. Purity and power — the spirit of the Rhinoceros in white.
